description: Numeric evidence records: each item binds one acceptance criterion (tolerance + literature/analytic source) to the committed artifact carrying the raw computed/reference pair. Graded by tensorbem.numeric_evidence; digests are pinned by --write.

items.criterion: Wall-sided barge displaced volume equals the analytic L*B*T to round-off (docs/hydrostatic_verification.md, exact-identity case)
items.reference_citation: Closed-form hydrostatics of a wall-sided box; identity, no discretisation error expected

items.criterion: Barge pitch restoring coefficient equals the analytic rho*g*I_L (docs/hydrostatic_verification.md)
items.reference_citation: c55 = rho*g*I_yy with I_yy = B*L^3/12 for a wall-sided box

items.criterion: Finest icosphere level (5 subdivisions, 4096 panels) reproduces the hemisphere displaced volume within 0.2% (second-order panel convergence, docs/hydrostatic_verification.md)
items.reference_citation: V = 2*pi*R^3/3 for a half-submerged sphere, R = 1 m

items.criterion: Finest icosphere level reproduces the hemisphere transverse metacentric height within 0.2% (docs/hydrostatic_verification.md)
items.reference_citation: GM = KB + BM - KG with BM = I_xx/V solved in closed form for a half-submerged sphere

items.criterion: Box hydrostatic roll restoring coefficient from the panel route equals the closed-form rho*g*I_xx (docs/rao_verification_metrics.json)
items.reference_citation: c44 = rho*g*I_xx + rho*g*V*KB for a wall-sided box

items.criterion: |dK_T| <= 3.0% at the design advance ratio J = 0.8 (verdict criteria C1, benchmarks/kp505_openwater_bem/verdict.json)
items.gap_note: The KP505 lattice closes to |dK_T| = 29.1% at J = 0.8 against the 3% design-point criterion (verdict.json status FAIL, 2/3 criteria failed). Registered as an accepted gap so the honest FAIL stays visible; closing it needs the unpublished chord/radial pitch particulars or a higher-fidelity lifting-surface model, not a tolerance change.
items.reference_citation: KP505 open-water experiment, Table 2 (anchor.source.doi in the same artifact)

items.criterion: |d eta_0| <= 5.0% at every anchor advance ratio in the physical range (verdict criteria C2, worst point J = 0.9)
items.gap_note: Worst efficiency error inside the physical J range is 24.4% at J = 0.9 against the 5% band (1 of 10 anchor points meets the band). Accepted gap, same model/geometry cause as the K_T row; the J = 1.0 outlier (787%) is outside the physical range and is reported in verdict.json rather than scored here.
items.reference_citation: KP505 open-water experiment, Table 2 efficiency derived from K_T, 10K_Q

items.criterion: Wigley parabolic hull form generator reproduces the analytic block coefficient Cb = 4/9 within 0.02% (geometry gate, docs/cummins_wigley_results.json gate W1)
items.reference_citation: Cb = 4/9 for the Wigley parabolic hull form (closed form of the generating equation)
